title: FLIR, Gimbal and GoFast Navy videos

tellings.quote: videos what they call colloquially the Flur the gimal the go fast video that show unidentified uh flying objects that the Pentagon has asserted are not ours and are not our adversaries and they date from events that happened in 2004 in 2015

plain: According to Karl Nell, who was the Army's representative on the Pentagon's UAP task force (UAP is the government's term for UFOs), three US Navy videos known as FLIR, Gimbal and Go Fast show unidentified flying objects that the Pentagon "has asserted are not ours and are not our adversaries." The first, named for the infrared camera that filmed it, comes from a 2004 encounter and shows the object called the Tic Tac, a white oval shaped like the mint, while Gimbal and Go Fast come from 2015. Nell says this on the show as a statement of the Pentagon's position, which, if it holds, would mean the objects were built by no nation anyone knows.
